'''Grebleips'''<ref name="SWShow">{{StarWarsShow|35wcXjhL22U|The Russo Brothers Love Star Wars 3,000|sw_url=video/the-russo-brothers-love-star-wars-3-000}}</ref> was an [[Asogian]]<ref name="Jedi Challenge" /> who served as a [[senator]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate]].<ref name="TPM" /> In [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], which includes Grebleips appearance, to [[32 BBY]].</ref> Grebleips was present for a session of the Senate in the [[Imperial Senate Building|Senate Building]] on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] in which [[Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] of the planet [[Naboo]] requested aid with the [[Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo|invasion]] of her [[homeworld]].<ref name="TPM" />

After Senators [[Lott Dod]] and [[Aks Moe]] stalled Amidala's request, she called for a [[Vote of No Confidence]] in [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]]. This sent the Senate into an uproar, and Grebleips and the two other aliens in the senator's [[repulsorpod]] stood and threw their arms up in the air along with many others, who cried out in response to the vote. Grebleips had [[Color|brown]] skin and wore no [[clothing]] while in the Senate Building.<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Senator Greblieps first appeared as a computer generated character in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" /> The character was included by [[George Lucas]] as a reference to the [[1982]] film [https://ettheextraterrestrial.fandom.com/wiki/E.T._the_Extra-Terrestrial_(film) ''E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial''], which had been made by his friend [[Steven Spielberg]] and included a child dressed as [[Yoda]] for Halloween as a reference to [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Jedi Challenge" /> In ''E.T.'', the title character, an alien from an unidentified planet, sees the face of Yoda and says "Home!" This led to a popular speculation that E.T. was a resident of the Star Wars galaxy and had met Yoda or another member of his species.

In the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Grebleips' name was first used in a [[2019]] episode of ''[[The Star Wars Show]]''.<ref name="SWShow" /> It originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was created by author [[James Luceno]] for the [[2001]] novel ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' as a further reference to Spielberg, as the name is Spielberg backwards.<ref name="CoD">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>
